_meta.feast: Holy and Righteous Virgin Juliana, Princess of Shanskaya
_meta._note: Polyeleos feast. 8 LIC stichera in Tone IV (3 + 3 + 2) + Glory Tone VI + Both Now Dogmatic Tone VI. Aposticha in Tone IV. Troparion Tone VIII. Single canon of the righteous one in Tone IV with Paraclysis (6 troparia) interleaved — Paraclysis omitted per pattern. Lauds: 4 stichera Tone IV + Glory Tone VI + Both now Tone VI. Gospel: Matthew §104 (Mt. 25:1-13).

troparion.text:
As an immaculate bride of Christ, the incorrupt Bridegroom,
O righteous virgin Juliana, with the radiant lamp of good works
thou didst enter into His heavenly bridal-chamber,
and there dost delight with the saints in eternal blessedness.
Wherefore, entreat Him Whom thou lovest,//
and to Whom thou didst betroth thy virginity, that He save our souls.
troparion.label: Troparion of the holy righteous one

kontakion.text:
We know thee to be an animate temple of God
right beautifully adorned with virginal purity, O holy and righteous virgin princess Juliana;
wherefore, celebrating the discovery of thy holy relics with love,
we beseech thee, O excellent mediatress of our desires:
Carry thy supplications for us to the Lord,
and by thine intercession at the throne of the Most High
free us from all misfortunes, that we may cry out to thee://
Rejoice, O holy virgin Juliana, most comely bride of Christ!
kontakion.label: Kontakion of the holy righteous one
kontakion.ikos:
Loving the purity beloved by angels, O holy and righteous virgin, thou didst blamelessly finish thine earthly life, having acquired in the flesh the ways of the angels; wherefore, thou dost now dwell in the mansions of paradise with the bodiless ones and all the saints, and hearest from us who honor thee these hymns of praise:
Rejoice, God-loving daughter of noble parents; Rejoice, thou who didst wondrously join a princely diadem with the crown of immortality!
Rejoice, thou who didst not desire to know an earthly betrothed instead of the heavenly One; Rejoice, thou who didst blamelessly preserve thy virginity for Christ alone!
Rejoice, thou who in thy youth didst love Jesus most sweet with all thy soul; Rejoice, thou who maintained thy fidelity to Him unto the end of thy life!
Rejoice, thou who hast been glorified by the Lord with incorruption and miracles; Rejoice, thou who abundantly pourest forth gracious healings!
Rejoice, ever-shining lamp illumining the Holy Church; Rejoice, priceless treasure given by God to the Lavra of the Caves!
Rejoice, cure for our bodies provided without any charge; Rejoice, diligent intercessor before the Lord for our souls!
Rejoice, O holy virgin Juliana, most comely bride of Christ!

stichera.melody: As one valiant among the martyrs

verses.text:
Adorned with the purity of virginity,
thou didst blamelessly and righteously
finish thine earthly course,
O right praiseworthy Juliana,
and by thy blessed end didst join thyself
to the immortal Bridegroom,
Who after thy death did splendidly glorify thee,
His beloved bride, with incorruption and miracles,
and in thee hath given us a tireless intercessor for our souls.

On the chariot of the virtues
thou didst mount to the habitations on high,
O beauteous virgin Juliana,
leaving us thy precious relics,
which blossom with incorruption
and pour forth miracles, as a rich inheritance.
Wherefore, celebrating their uncovering with splendor,
we beseech thee, O bride of Christ:
Pray thou continuously to the Lord on behalf of our souls.

Wounded in heart by the beauty
of the incorrupt Bridegroom,
thou didst love Him with all thy soul, O virgin Juliana;
and preserving thy virginity unsullied for Him,
thou wast deemed worthy to enter into His bridal-chamber.
Delighting there in endless blessedness with the saints,
in thy supplications to the Lord remember those
who honor thy holy memory with love,
and pray thou for our souls.

glory.text: Standing at the right hand of Christ the Savior, in the choir of the holy virgins, O virgin princess Juliana, thou delightest in the contemplation of His most radiant face. Having thyself received unwaning radiance therefrom, thou shinest forth graciously upon those in the darkness of passions and tribulations, imparting healings unto the sick who with faith hasten to the shrine of thy holy relics. Wherefore, by thy supplications preserve us from ailments of soul and body, and win for us the inheritance of the kingdom of heaven.

bothNow.text:
Who doth not call thee blessed, O most holy Virgin?
Who will not hymn thy most pure birthgiving?
For the only-begotten Son Who hath shone forth timelessly from the Father,
came forth, ineffably incarnate, from thee, O pure one;
By nature he is God, by nature for our sakes, he hath become a man
not divided into two Hypostases,
but known in two natures without commingling.
Him do thou beseech, O pure and most blessed one,
that our souls find mercy!
bothNow.label: Dogmatic Theotokion

verses.text:
Thou didst restrain the temporal passions,
and cast off the pleasures of the flesh, O blessed Juliana,
remaining in unsullied virginity from thy youth,
that thou mightest be well-pleasing to Jesus most sweet,
Who loved the beauty of thy soul,
and betrothed thee as an incorrupt bride for Himself.
Having acquired boldness before Him;
by thy supplications preserve the city and monastery which keep thy precious relics;
and pray thou continually for those who honor thy holy memory.

verses.psalmVerse: Wondrous is God in His saints, * the God of Israel.
verses.text:
Thy comeliness of body and the divine beauty of thy soul
were wondrously yoked together, O most comely virgin Juliana,
rendering thee truly worthy of the immortal Bridegroom,
Who chose and loved thee, and enriched thee greatly with spiritual gifts.
And clad in them as with robes,
thou didst enter His bridal-chamber in paradise,
and there received the crown of the heavenly kingdom from the hand of the Ruler of all.
Standing before Him in never-waning glory,
pray thou continually for those who honor thy holy memory.

verses.psalmVerse: In congregations bless ye God, * the Lord from the wellsprings of Israel.
verses.text:
Standing round about thine honored shrine,
O good and ever-glorious virgin Juliana,
we offer thee hymns of praise as is meet,
as to one who prayeth for us at the throne of the Lord of glory,
imparting gifts of healing in abundance unto those
who have recourse to thee with faith.
Deprive us not also thereof, for we stand in need of thine aid;
and pray thou to the Lord on behalf of those
who honor thy holy memory.

glory.text: The heights of nobility and worldly comforts did not wrest thy heart away from the love of Christ, O righteous Juliana; wherefore, to thy princely diadem thou didst join the incorrupt crown of betrothal to Christ, and through holiness and purity didst wed thyself to Him Who is more comely than the sons of mankind. Having united thyself with Him through mighty love, thou dost now dance in splendor in the mansions of paradise, as a most comely virgin and bride of Christ.

bothNow.text:
Christ the Lord, my Creator and Redeemer,
Who came forth from thy womb, O most pure one,
and clothed Himself in my nature,
hath freed Adam from the primal curse.
Wherefore, like the angel
we unceasingly cry out to thee,
O most pure one,
who art truly the Mother of God and Virgin:
Rejoice!, O Sovereign Lady,
the intercession, protection and salvation of our souls!
bothNow.label: Theotokion

troparion.text:
As an immaculate bride of Christ, the incorrupt Bridegroom,
O righteous virgin Juliana, with the radiant lamp of good works
thou didst enter into His heavenly bridal-chamber,
and there dost delight with the saints in eternal blessedness.
Wherefore, entreat Him Whom thou lovest,//
and to Whom thou didst betroth thy virginity, that He save our souls.
troparion.label: Troparion of the righteous one

sedalion.text: Having finished this temporal life in piety, by thy blessed end thou didst pass over to life immortal, O most honored Juliana. Like a full moon thou shinest forth rays of never-waning light, illumining the night of our passions and sufferings with the effulgence of the many miracles wherewith thou hast been enriched by the Lord Who hath crowned thee with a crown of incorrupt glory. Entreat Him on behalf of us who celebrate thy memory.
sedalion.label: Sessional Hymn (after Kathisma 1)

bothNow.text:
O fervent and invincible intercessor,
diligent and unashamed hope,
rampart, protection and haven
of those who have recourse to thee,
O pure Ever-virgin do thou, together with the angels,
entreat thy Son and God,
that He grant peace, salvation and great mercy to the world.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

sedalion.text: A wellspring of healings, O right laudable Juliana, hath thy tomb been shown to be, which the earth did not conceal, but put forth from its bosom for our enrichment. And beholding thy relics therein, blossoming with incorruption, we rejoice and give thanks to the Lord Who hath vouchsafed us such a gift. Him do thou ever entreat for the salvation of our souls.
sedalion.label: Sessional Hymn (after Kathisma 2)

bothNow.text:
O Theotokos, accept the supplications of thy servants,
and deliver us from all tribulation,
for thou hast given birth to Christ the Savior,
the Redeemer of our souls.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

verses: With patience I waited patiently for the Lord, and He was attentive unto me, and He hearkened unto my supplication.
Glory… Both now… Alleluia… Glory to Thee, O God!

sessionalHymnAfterPolyeleios.text: Having divinely wedded thyself unto the Lord, for Him alone didst thou preserve thy virginity immaculate, O virgin Juliana, and thou didst receive His divine bridal-chamber as an everlasting inheritance, illumined with the radiant brilliance of the effulgence of heaven. Wherefore, having received never-waning splendor, illumine our darkened souls with rays of the grace of God, and entreat Christ God, that He grant remission of sins unto those who honor thy holy memory with love.
sessionalHymnAfterPolyeleios.label: Sessional Hymn after the Polyeleos

bothNow.text: Through the supplications of the Theotokos, Thy good Mother who knew not a man, O Christ, of Thine incorporeal ones, and Thy forerunner, the apostles, prophets, martyrs, and all the saints, grant that we may walk in Thy light; and in the loving-kindness of Thy mercy grant that we may inherit Thy kingdom.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

prokeimenon.refrain:
Wondrous is God in His saints,
the God of Israel.
prokeimenon.verse: In congregations bless ye God, the Lord from the wellsprings of Israel.

gospel._note: The Parable of the Ten Virgins.

postGospelSticheron.text: The pleasures of life which drag us down, and the glory of the princely state, didst thou spurn out of love for Christ, O blessed Juliana, and while yet of a youthful age thou didst display spiritual wisdom, wherewith thou didst render impotent all the darts of the temptations of the enemy; and as one victorious thou didst receive a crown of heavenly glory from the right hand of the Most High. Him do thou entreat, that He grant us eternal blessedness.
postGospelSticheron.label: Sticheron after Psalm 50

canon._author: Canon of the holy righteous one in Tone IV. Canon of Supplication to the Theotokos (Paraclysis, 6 troparia) interleaved at service — Paraclysis troparia omitted per pattern.
canon._canonNote: Katavasiae: 'I shall open my mouth...' (Theotokos canon Irmos used as katavasia).

ode1.irmos:
I shall open my mouth,
and be filled with the Spirit,
and utter discourse to the Queen and Mother;
and be seen radiantly keeping festival,
joyfully praising her wonders.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: O Jesus, King of hosts, immortal Word of God: Grant me the discourse and intelligence, that I may hymn Thine immaculate bride, the righteous virgin Juliana, whom Thou hast radiantly glorified with incorruption and miracles.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: Wounded with desire for immortal life and the beauty of Him Who is more comely than all the sons of mankind, with captivated heart, thou didst hasten after Him with faith, O divinely wise Juliana.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: In a godly manner thou didst array thyself in garments of purity, and clothe thyself in the vesture of immaculate virginity, O beauteous virgin. Wherefore, Christ loved the comeliness of thy soul.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text: Theotokion: Strengthened by the grace of Him Who shone forth from thy womb, O all-immaculate one, the choirs of virgins were led in unto Him in thy train, rejoicing and crying aloud: Thou art the boast of the virginal!

ode1.katavasia:
I shall open my mouth,
and be filled with the Spirit,
and utter discourse to the Queen and Mother;
and be seen radiantly keeping festival,
joyfully praising her wonders.

ode3.irmos:
O Theotokos, thou living and plentiful fount,
establish in spiritual fellowship those who sing hymns to thee,
and in thy divine glory
grant them crowns of glory.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: Strengthened by the power of God, O Juliana, while yet in thy youth thou didst overcome the uprisings of the passions, having one desire: faithfully to be well-pleasing unto Christ alone, and to serve Him blamelessly in holiness and purity.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: A divine miracle of the goodness of God was revealed in thee, O holy virgin, how thou, a young maiden, didst vanquish the machinations of ancient Belial, for in thy weakness was the power of God gloriously glorified.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: Thou didst love heavenly wisdom from childhood, O unblemished ewe-lamb Juliana, and instructed therein, thou didst consider the glory of princely rank, riches and beauty to be as naught, that thou mightest be pleasing unto Christ.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text: Theotokion: Reasoning in an Orthodox manner, we proclaim thee to be the true and all-immaculate Mother of God; for through thee was the Creator pleased to unite Himself with us.

ode3.katavasia:
O Theotokos, thou living and plentiful fount,
establish in spiritual fellowship those who sing hymns to thee,
and in thy divine glory
grant them crowns of glory.

sedalenAfterOde3.text: Adorned with the beauty of virginity, O immaculate bride, holy virgin Juliana, thou didst enter, rejoicing, into the bridal-chamber of Christ, where the choirs of the angels and the councils of the saints lovingly greeted thee, and the King of glory Himself, thy beloved Bridegroom, looked mercifully upon thee, and crowned thee with a crown of immortality. Him do thou entreat, O most blessed one, that He not deprive us, who are made of earth and dust, of the inheritance of His kingdom.
sedalenAfterOde3.label: Sessional Hymn (after Ode 3)

bothNow.text:
O pure and all-immaculate one, who knewest not wedlock,
who alone hast given birth in time to the timeless Son and Word of God:
With the holy and honorable apostles, martyrs, prophets and the venerable,
entreat Him, that He grant us cleansing and great mercy.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

ode4.irmos:
He who sitteth in glory upon the throne of the Godhead,
Jesus the true God,
is come in a swift cloud
and with His sinless hands he hath saved those who cry:
Glory to Thy power, O Christ.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: To the sounds of angelic hymnody thou didst enter into marriage with the Lamb, O Juliana, bride of Christ, and didst receive the grace of miracles as a token of thy betrothal to Christ, wherewith thou didst treat the infirmities of mankind.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: With divine miracles and the incorruption of thy virginal body dost thou assure us that thy life was well-pleasing unto God, O favorite of God, and that thou hast received a heavenly reward with the saints.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: Thou didst offer gifts unto Christ: an unsullied virginity, a silent mouth and a meek heart, O blessed Juliana; and by the labors of asceticism thou didst win the kingdom of heaven, wherein thou dost delight in everlasting blessedness.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text: Theotokion: Like rain upon the fleece which the Prophet Gideon beheld of old, the Lord descended upon thy womb, O all-immaculate one. Thou hast given birth to Him in two natures for the salvation of us who cry aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Christ!

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: Like a treasure of great price were thy relics, blossoming with incorruption, found in the earth through the wondrous providence of God, O holy virgin Juliana; for thou didst most beautifully rest in the grave with a radiant face and the ornaments of virginity, unharmed by corruption.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: Having died in the body, thou art alive in spirit, O God-pleasing princess; wherefore, thou didst appear in a vision to Peter, the first hierarch of the Church of Kiev, commanding Him to render fitting honor to thy relics.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: Acknowledging thy holiness, the holy hierarch Peter had thy holy relics clad in new and magnificent garments, O righteous Juliana; and he placed them with honor in the Great Church, and decreed that thy memory ever be celebrated, in that thou art a true favorite of God.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text: Theotokion: Raise me up who have fallen into the pit of the passions, and guide me to the haven of salvation, O only all-immaculate one who hast given birth to God the Helmsman Who by grace hath united those above to those below, who had formerly been separated.

ode6.irmos:
Celebrating the divine and solemn feast
of the Mother of God,
O ye divinely wise,
let us come, clapping our hands,
and glorify God who was born of her.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: The mindless and sacrilegious robber who stole the ring from thy hand didst thou punish terribly, O favorite of God, for he straightway bitterly gave up his soul at the entrance to the church and fell prey to the devil.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: Desiring to assure the right reverend abbot that thou didst truly rest with the saints in the mansions of paradise, thou didst appear to him in a vision among a choir of holy virgins, O blessed Juliana, and upbraid him for not believing that thou hadst been numbered by God among the holy virgins who were well-pleasing to Him.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: Thy holy relics pour forth healings upon the infirm, O princess Juliana, and the demons tremble before them; for great power is given thee by God against unclean spirits. From their oppression free us also through thy right acceptable supplications.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text: Theotokion: Beholding the fulfillment of thy words, we magnify thee who hast magnified our race, O Mother of God; for giving birth unto One of the Trinity thou didst become an animate chariot of the Godhead. Wherefore, all generations now truly call thee blessed.

ode6.katavasia:
Celebrating the divine and solemn feast
of the Mother of God,
O ye divinely wise,
let us come, clapping our hands,
and glorify God who was born of her.

kontakion.text:
We know thee to be an animate temple of God
right beautifully adorned with virginal purity, O holy and righteous virgin princess Juliana;
wherefore, celebrating the discovery of thy holy relics with love,
we beseech thee, O excellent mediatress of our desires:
Carry thy supplications for us to the Lord,
and by thine intercession at the throne of the Most High
free us from all misfortunes, that we may cry out to thee://
Rejoice, O holy virgin Juliana, most comely bride of Christ!
kontakion.label: Kontakion of the holy righteous one

ikos.text:
Loving the purity beloved by angels, O holy and righteous virgin, thou didst blamelessly finish thine earthly life, having acquired in the flesh the ways of the angels; wherefore, thou dost now dwell in the mansions of paradise with the bodiless ones and all the saints, and hearest from us who honor thee these hymns of praise:
Rejoice, God-loving daughter of noble parents; Rejoice, thou who didst wondrously join a princely diadem with the crown of immortality!
Rejoice, thou who didst not desire to know an earthly betrothed instead of the heavenly One; Rejoice, thou who didst blamelessly preserve thy virginity for Christ alone!
Rejoice, thou who in thy youth didst love Jesus most sweet with all thy soul; Rejoice, thou who maintained thy fidelity to Him unto the end of thy life!
Rejoice, thou who hast been glorified by the Lord with incorruption and miracles; Rejoice, thou who abundantly pourest forth gracious healings!
Rejoice, ever-shining lamp illumining the Holy Church; Rejoice, priceless treasure given by God to the Lavra of the Caves!
Rejoice, cure for our bodies provided without any charge; Rejoice, diligent intercessor before the Lord for our souls!
Rejoice, O holy virgin Juliana, most comely bride of Christ!

ode7.irmos:
Refusing to worship created things
in place of the Creator,
the divinely wise youths bravely trampled down the threatening fire
and rejoicing they sang aloud:
O supremely hymned Lord and God of our Fathers, Blessed art Thou.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: Even though death touched thee through the law of nature, O divinely wise Juliana, thou dost yet emit rays of immortality from thy tomb; for clothed with life-bearing mortality in Christ, thou didst most beautifully blossom forth with miraculous incorruption.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: The laws of nature were altered in thee in a manner past understanding and comprehension, O wondrous virgin Juliana; for lying for many years in a grave in the bosom of the earth, thou wast shown to be incorrupt, thy face blossoming, as one who in the Lord slept the sleep of the righteous.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: Desiring to behold the beauty of the most radiant countenance of Christ, O pure virgin, thou didst reject an earthly bridegroom, that thou mightest wed thyself to Christ forever. And thou didst offer immaculate purity unto Him as a costly dowry. Wherefore, He loved the beauty of thy soul.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text: Theotokion: Spare me, O Christ, when thou wilt judge the earth with glory. Dispel the gloom of my passions through the supplications of the immaculate Virgin who gave Thee birth, and with her receive also the righteous Juliana who prayeth for me, in that Thou art good and great in mercy.

ode8.irmos:
The Offspring of the Theotokos
saved the holy children in the furnace.
He who was then prefigured hath now been born on earth,
and He gathereth all creation to hymn thee:
all ye works praise ye the Lord
and supremely exalt Him throughout all ages.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text: Thy splendid memorial is joy for the faithful, O blessed Juliana, for therein hath the triumph of Orthodoxy been revealed; for only in the bosom of the One Orthodox Church doth grace-bearing incorruption flourish, wherewith thou hast been divinely invested, receiving fitting honor.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text: Christ gave thee an inexhaustible wealth of healings, O maiden, and instead of an earthly principality enriched thee with the inheritance of a heavenly kingdom, as one who loved Him sincerely with all thy soul. Wherefore, entreat His goodness, that He not deprive us, who are darkened, of enlightenment from on high and the goodly portion of the saints.

troparia.refrain: We praise, bless and worship the Lord, singing and exalting Him throughout all ages!
troparia.text: Thy holy relics pour forth streams of healing, O God-pleasing princess, wherewith thou dost bedew our souls with grace, and healest our bodies of multifarious ailments: for thou hast received rich gifts of healing from the Lord.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text: Theotokion: O thou who hast given birth to the hypostatic Wisdom, the pre-eternal Word, the Physician of souls and bodies, heal thou the sores and wounds of my soul, which are grievous and of long standing, and assuage the pain of my heart, O Virgin.

ode8.katavasia:
The Offspring of the Theotokos
saved the holy children in the furnace.
He who was then prefigured hath now been born on earth,
and He gathereth all creation to hymn thee:
all ye works praise ye the Lord
and supremely exalt Him throughout all ages.

ode9.irmos:
Let every mortal born on earth,
radiant with light, in spirit leap for joy;
and let the host of the angelic powers
celebrate and honor the holy feast of the Mother of God,
and let them cry aloud:
Rejoice! O all-blessed Theotokos,
thou pure Ever-Virgin.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: The Holy Lavra of the Caves danceth, having thy wonder-working relics as a priceless treasure, O Juliana, from whence, as from an inexhaustible wellspring, thou pourest forth healings upon the faithful; wherefore, with love we bless thee with hymns of praise.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: Thou hast been shown to be like a radiant star illumining the noetic heaven of the Lavra of the Caves with grace, O righteous virgin; and with the purity of thy life thou shinest upon all who desire to live in holiness of life, that through thee all might be sanctified by the love of Christ God.

troparia.refrain: Holy righteous Juliana, pray to God for us!
troparia.text: O immaculate turtle-dove, thou didst fly beneath the shelter of the heavenly Eagle, and didst find goodly rest with Him, O right praiseworthy Juliana. Bear thou our thoughts up to Him, and teach us to emulate the purity of thy life and thy fervent love for Christ God.

troparia.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us!
troparia.text: Theotokion: Blessed is the Fruit of thy blessed womb, O pure one, Whom the hosts of heaven and the assemblies of mankind bless, and Who hath delivered us from the primal curse, O blessed Virgin.

ode9.katavasia:
Let every mortal born on earth,
radiant with light, in spirit leap for joy;
and let the host of the angelic powers
celebrate and honor the holy feast of the Mother of God,
and let them cry aloud:
Rejoice! O all-blessed Theotokos,
thou pure Ever-Virgin.

exapostilarion.text: We see thee in the heavenly bridal-chamber of Christ God, O holy virgin; and desiring to partake of the same beauty, we beseech thee with great compunction: Light thou our flickering lamp with the oil of thy good works, and aid us to meet the Lord with the wise virgins, and to receive the goodly portion of those who stand at His right hand and glorify Him forever.
exapostilarion.label: Exapostilarion of the holy righteous one

bothNow.text: All my hope do I set upon thee, O Mother of God. Keep me beneath the shelter of thy wings.
bothNow.label: Theotokion

lauds.melody: As one valiant among the martyrs

stichera.text: Thy life was hidden in God, O Juliana, and thy virtues were concealed from the knowledge of mortals; yet Christ, the Judge of the contest, Whom thou didst faithfully serve in humility, silence and meekness of heart, after thy death glorified thee in the sight of all through wondrous incorruption and many miracles, for the Lord knoweth how to openly glorify His secret servants, who labor blamelessly for Him. Entreat Him, O favorite of God, that He grant our souls remission of sins and great mercy.

By the radiant face of thine incorrupt body thou didst manifestly show forth the unfading splendor of thy soul when it was discovered in the bosom of the earth, O Juliana; for corruption did not dare to touch what had been united to Christ forever with an unbreakable bond. Him do thou beseech, O righteous virgin, that He grant unto our souls remission of sins and great mercy.

Thou didst righteously and blamelessly finish thine earthly life, O venerable princess, who lived most calmly in the world and in the years of thy youth attained the spiritual perfection to become like the angels in thy ways. Wherefore, thy holy soul now dwelleth with the angels, and thy virginal body hath been honored with incorruption and glorified by the Lord with miracles. Him do thou entreat, O blessed Juliana, that He grant unto our souls remission of sins and great mercy.

doxastikon.text: Come, ye assemblies of the faithful! Come, ye choirs of virgins! Let us honor Princess Juliana, the righteous virgin, with hymns of praise, for she was well-pleasing to Christ in her youth, and like a young deer ran quickly to the mountain of heaven, to receive the reward for her virginal struggles from the just Judge of the contest Who rewardeth each according to his deeds. Wherefore, O brethren, let us emulate her purity and acquire her love for Christ God, that we may find Him merciful on the day of judgment.

theotokion.text:
All my hope do I set upon thee, O Mother of God.
Keep me beneath the shelter of thy wings.
theotokion.label: Both now

troparionAfterDoxology.text:
As an immaculate bride of Christ, the incorrupt Bridegroom,
O righteous virgin Juliana, with the radiant lamp of good works
thou didst enter into His heavenly bridal-chamber,
and there dost delight with the saints in eternal blessedness.
Wherefore, entreat Him Whom thou lovest,//
and to Whom thou didst betroth thy virginity, that He save our souls.
troparionAfterDoxology.label: Troparion of the righteous one
